On an x86_64 emulator, a crash inside the emulator's ARM translator while Messenger forks a helper process is still reported, but it no longer counts as a Messenger crash, since a phone doesn't run that translator.
- `scripts/walk-app.ps1` closes the keyboard before it reads each screen. A chat with no messages yet puts the cursor in the message box, the keyboard comes up, and with it open the screen read failed, so the walk reported the chat as having no screen to check. The keyboard can also come up a moment after the chat loads, so the walk checks again after closing it and tries the screen read up to three times.
- Publish now writes the GitHub release notes in the layout v0.27.0's notes were redone in by hand. They open with the release summary, then carry every CHANGELOG bullet word for word under New in this release, Fixes and changes and Behind the scenes, followed by the reports the release touched, How to update, and What was checked, which comes from the walk that cleared the bundle. Publish stops before tagging when a bullet would go missing or a line uses a dash.
- The release check refuses a bundle that isn't signed, was signed with a key other than the one in `morphe-signing.pub`, or was changed after signing. It also wants that key in the source's `public_key` and its fingerprint in the README. `release.ps1` reads the private key from `-BundleKey` and the build signs with it, while everyday builds without the key stay unsigned.
- The settings screen's code is split up. Auto reply's sheet, the message log viewer, theme colors, the choices backup, the custom font rows, the update check and Copy setup each have a file of their own now, which takes the settings page itself from about 3,600 lines to about 1,500. Nothing you see or tap changed.
- The build moved to Gradle 9.8.2 and Kotlin 2.4.21, both bugfix releases. The patches used to mix Kotlin 2.4.20 and 2.4.21 across the compiler, plugin and library, and now one version covers all three. The bundle's classes still target Java 11.

### Reports this release changed something for

#42, #70, #75, #90, #101, #103, #104, #108, #113, #114, #115, #116, #117, #118 and #119.

Full history is in the [changelog](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushMessenger/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).

### How to update

1. Update Messenger to 585.0.0.53.94 first. Any build on [APKMirror's 585.0.0.53.94 page](https://www.apkmirror.com/apk/facebook-2/messenger/facebook-messenger-585-0-0-53-94-release/) works, and a `nodpi` one keeps the icons sharp.
2. In Morphe Manager (2.3.0 or newer), open **Sources** and refresh HushMessenger. The card should say **71 patches**.
3. Patch Messenger again and install it over your current one. Your settings carry over.

Patching on a computer? `patches-0.28.0.mpp` below is the same bundle for Morphe Desktop 1.20.0 or newer. It's a patch bundle, not a Messenger APK. `SHA256SUMS.txt` and its signature let you check the download, and the README says how.

### What was checked

- The full test suite, plus a patch run against all 7 Messenger 585.0.0.53.94 builds on file.
- Morphe Desktop patched and rebuilt one APK from each of the 4 build families.
- An APK patched from this exact bundle was installed on an emulator on Android API 32, signed in to Messenger. A chat, the inbox, both HushMessenger settings tabs, the message log, auto reply, Messenger's own settings, story settings and contact settings all opened, with no crashes.

hushfeed.title: v0.80.0
hushfeed.body:
Hushfeed v0.80.0 has 143 patches for global TikTok 47.6.3 (`com.zhiliaoapp.musically`), and it's TikTok only now. PineDrama moved to its own patch set, [HushPine](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushPine), so add that source in Morphe Manager to keep patching PineDrama. This bundle is built on Morphe patcher 2.1.0. Update Morphe Manager to 2.3.0 or newer before you patch (or use morphe-desktop 1.20.0 on a computer), because older ones won't load it.

TikTok moves to 47.6.3, so grab that build from APKMirror and keep the same signing key. Your login and settings carry over. You can lock the feed during hours you pick, keep saves off mobile data, slide to change the hold speed and turn the bottom bar into a floating glass pill. Messages someone unsends can stay in the chat, a double tap can take a like back off, and every patch has Morphe options for its starting values.

Here's every report this release changed something for, and what changed.

For bug reports

* Passkey sign-in (#102). `Sign in without a passkey` says what to do when TikTok's 2-step check still asks only for a passkey.
* Missing notifications (#126, #222, #86). Diagnostics counts how many notifications were registered and posted, and leaves out what they said.
* Lag when a video starts (#150). Startup checks record which player drew the first frame, timed with a clock that never jumps backward.
* A video playing behind the comments (#151). The comment pause can tell the first frame is playing before TikTok sends its first progress update.
* Low download quality (#240). Saving on Automatic takes the tallest copy other players can open when it beats TikTok's own file, which is often the 1080p HEVC one.
* Tabs over LIVE and drama text (#250). With `See-through bottom bar` on, the name and "Tap to watch" line stay above the tabs.
* Comments beside the video (#253). It measures its width the same way when it lays out and when it decides whether to rebuild.
* Two videos playing at once (#257). The video stays paused when a link in its comments opens another page.
* The Caution label in messages (#258). `Hide unverified content notices` takes it off videos people share with you too, and country flags stay next to names written right to left.
* Full height comments under the status bar (#261). The sheet stops below the clock, and the first video after opening TikTok gets the full height too. The "Swipe up to skip" line on suggested accounts sits above the tabs again.
* The activity center in AMOLED (#263). Its card is black, or your picked color, instead of TikTok's dark gray.
* Dark text in a LIVE comment box (#267). What you type there reads light on the AMOLED dark theme.
* Likes missing from Liked (#269). Videos you liked or saved stay on your Liked and Favorites grids even with an ad or paid partnership mark, and a like TikTok turns down now tells you why.
* Profile links from Telegram (#276). Each link replaces the pages you opened from the last one, and Back from the profile goes straight to the chat.
* LIVEs in the feed (#277). `Hide LIVE videos` catches the ones TikTok slips into a page that's already on screen.
* Face effects that can't find a face (#285). `Remove creation tools` doesn't empty the face model on its own anymore. Leave that patch out if you use face effects or make videos.
* Streaks with emoji or group names (#289). `Keep a streak going` reaches names with an emoji or a space in them, and group chats.
* Automatic Clear display (#84). A second video opened from Favorites, Likes or a profile doesn't flash the search bar before it clears.
* The Service+ line under LIVEs (#94). `Hide the Service+ row under LIVE previews` keeps it off, and the line stays with its own LIVE.

For feature requests and contributions

* Sharper story saves (#155, #287). Saving a story on Automatic takes the sharpest copy it has. Thanks to @jutochoppa.
* Stickers (#156, #88). `Create stickers` puts a Create button on the sticker panel's Saved page and `Make sticker` on a video's share sheet, and `Keep recent stickers` keeps the Recently used row after a restart. PineDrama support, the rest of #156, lives in HushPine now.
* Better sorting (#180). Liked grids get their own sort.
* Latest on Following (#226). With `Latest first on Following` on, every read after the first asks TikTok for 30 posts.
* Bands between videos (#232). The cover still TikTok flashes between videos grows with the picture under the see-through bars.
* Stories for creators who are LIVE (#233). `Open the Story when a creator is LIVE` works on a creator's profile picture too.
* The Auto scroll button on foldables (#234). `Hide TikTok's Auto scroll button` also hides the round one at the top right.
* Links in bios (#247). An @username in a bio opens that profile, and a long press on someone else's bio copies it.
* Hold speed slider and double tap unlike (#248). `Slide to change the hold speed` and the `Like or unlike the video` choice come from OmerKurdi79's fork.
* Search from a gesture (#251). `Double tap` and `Long press` can open TikTok's search page, and `Hide the Back button there too` clears the top of opened videos.
* A smaller comment search (#254). `Fold the search into a button` turns the box into a magnifier.
* Starting values for settings (#256). Every patch with settings has Morphe options for them. Thanks to @XEGARE.
* The glass bottom bar (#259). The main feed's bottom bar can be a floating glass pill. Thanks to @amfakh, whose pull request it's based on.
* The LIVE row on Following (#262). `Hide the LIVE row on Following` takes it away.
* The Hushfeed row in TikTok's settings (#264). `Hide the Hushfeed row` takes it out.
* LIVE recordings (#265). Recording a LIVE's screen doesn't film the Record button, and the notification has a Stop button.
* Copying from a LIVE profile card (#268). Long press the bio, name or username to copy it.
* Shop buttons under captions (#271). `Hide TikTok Shop` takes those out too.
* MP3 saves (#273). `Sound format` has an MP3 choice.
* The sticker save box (#274). `Save box for chat stickers` turns it off.
* Material You icons (#280). `Custom launcher icon` has a Material You style and an icon background color.
* Auto translate (#282). `Auto translate comments` works on TikTok's newer comment list, and the translate icon's off state holds.
* Music from other apps (#283). `Let other apps play until a video starts` keeps it playing until a video does.
* Ads in microseries (#286). `Remove feed ads` refuses the ads microseries ask for in their player.
* Unsent messages (#291). `Keep unsent messages` keeps them in the chat. Thanks to @maayan080.
* Interested buttons on videos (#293). `Hide surveys` hides them.
* A sharper notification icon (Discussion #114). `Custom launcher icon` has a `Notification icon` option.
* Blocking a LIVE host (Discussion #138). `Block author button` works on LIVEs in For You.

New in this release

- PineDrama moved out to its own repo, [HushPine](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushPine), with its own patches and releases. Hushfeed is TikTok only from here on, and `Allow photo comments` went with PineDrama.
- Hushfeed now supports TikTok 47.6.3, and only that one. 47.5.3 isn't supported anymore. Grab the 47.6.3 bundle or APK from APKMirror and patch it with the same signing key, so your login and settings carry over.
- `Hide the Clear display controls` has a new `Keep the progress bar` switch under it. The exit and pause buttons still go, but the progress bar stays on screen so you can see where you are and drag it (#237).
- `Double tap` has a new `Like or unlike the video` choice. A double tap on a video you've already liked takes the like back off, the same as tapping the heart, and `Confirm before liking` still asks first. TikTok's default double tap still only likes, and it works for each corner with `Double tap by corner` too (#248).
- `Slide to change the hold speed` lets you pick the speed while you hold a video. Slide left or right and it steps through your own `Speed menu choices`, with a bubble near the top showing the speed. Let go and the video goes back to its usual speed, and your next hold starts at the speed you slid to. With `Lock the hold speed with a pull down` on, pulling down locks the speed you slid to, and unlocking plays your default speed when `Use a default playback speed` is on. It's off by default and sits right under `Speed while you hold the video`. The idea comes from OmerKurdi79's fork (#248).
- Liked grids get their own sort. `Sort loaded videos on Liked grids` starts at `Same as profile grids`, so nothing changes until you pick something else, and the sort button on a Liked grid now changes only the Liked order. Posts, Favorites and private videos still follow the profile setting, and other kinds of grids keep TikTok's order (#180).
- Every Hushfeed title (the settings bar, its dialogs, the Feature Gate Lab and the lock screen) now wears TikTok's cyan and red in a slow moving gradient, and it keeps moving even with Android's animations turned off.
- The Calm feed preset is gone from the top of Feed filter. The filters it used to flip are all still there, and whatever you turned on with it stays on.
- `Double tap` and `Long press` can open TikTok's search page now. It works with `Hide feed search button` on too, so you can hide the button and still get to Search (#251).
- `Fold the search into a button` puts a magnifier at the top left of the comments in place of the search box. Tap it to search, and searching (or another tap) folds the box away again. Your search keeps filtering, and the result line stays so you can tell (#254).
- `Hide the Hushfeed row` takes Hushfeed out of TikTok's Settings and privacy. Press and hold For You at the top of the feed to open the settings after that, or Home when `Long-press Home for Hushfeed settings` is on. Pausing Hushfeed brings the row back (#264).
- An @username typed into someone's bio is a link now, like the ones TikTok already links. Tap it and that profile opens. Tapping the rest of the bio still translates it, and a long press still copies it. A name right after "IG:" or "Snap" stays plain, since it belongs to another app. Turn it off with `Tap @names in bios` (#247).
- The main feed's bottom bar can be a floating glass pill now. A lens slides across the tabs as you switch, you can slide along the pill to change tabs, and haptics are optional. Interface has new settings for the blur, the glass opacity, the pill's height and its corners (#259).
- Every patch with settings now has Morphe options that pick its starting values, so a build can ship with the switches you want already on. Saved choices still win, and Reset goes back to the value you picked. Thanks to @XEGARE (#256).
- `Hide the LIVE row on Following` takes away the row of LIVE and story circles at the top of Following, along with the Story pill that opens it. The video starts right under the tabs with no empty band, and it stays that way after a swipe or Clear display. For You and the LIVE tab look the same as before (#262).
- `Skip the Share to sheet after a save` stops the Share to sheet TikTok pops up a few seconds after its own downloader saves a video. The share button works like before and the saved notice still shows.
- `Save details beside the video` covers photo posts now. Saving a post's original photos also writes one file for the whole post with its caption, creator, link and post date, plus which photos you picked and which ones saved. `Save details as JSON` works for it too. A Retry after some photos failed updates that same file instead of adding a second one, and if the file can't be written you're told separately from the photos.
- Search knows the everyday names for a few features now. Try "autoplay", "PiP", "AI" or "save photos". It also finds a choice row by any of its options, whichever one it's set to. Search "save the frame" and `Double tap` comes up, and tapping it opens its list of choices. Titles that match what you typed still come first.
- `Lock the feed at set times` locks the feed by itself during hours you pick, like `Mon-Fri 21:00-07:00; Sat Sun 13:00-15:00`. Leave the days out and it's every day, and a time that ends before it starts runs past midnight. It follows your phone's clock, daylight saving changes included. The lock panel says when it opens again, and the row shows when the next lock starts. Messages, profiles and search still work while it's on. A spent daily budget still wins, and Pause Hushfeed turns it off. Cutting hours waits a day, just like budget changes do, and you can't take hours off a day that's already locked.
- `Save only on Wi-Fi` keeps saves off mobile data. On a metered network, or when the phone can't tell, a save waits for Wi-Fi (or any network that isn't metered) for up to 30 minutes. A waiting save doesn't take one of the `Saves at once` spots, and you can cancel it from the Downloads page. Leave Wi-Fi in the middle of a save and it stops cleanly, with the finished files kept. Saving a frame still works anywhere. It's off by default.
- `Save box for chat stickers` in Downloads turns off the Save media box Hushfeed opens when you tap a sticker someone sent you in a chat. With it off, the tap only does what TikTok does (#274).
- `Let other apps play until a video starts` sits under `Mute feed videos` in Playback. With it on, opening TikTok or going back and forth to your messages doesn't pause music from another app anymore. TikTok takes the sound once a video actually plays. It's off by default (#283).
- New `Keep unsent messages` switch in Inbox. When someone unsends a message to you, it stays in the chat, and `Mark kept messages` can add "(unsent)" after it. Messages you unsend yourself still go away, and `Clear kept messages` turns the kept ones back into TikTok's usual notice. It's off by default. Thanks to @maayan080 (#291).
- `Hide the Service+ row under LIVE previews` sits with the LIVE switches in Playback. A LIVE in the feed can carry a Service+ line under the creator's name, like "Ask me anything", and this keeps it off. The line also stays with its own LIVE now. It used to hang on from the LIVE before whenever the row came back on screen, so a LIVE with no Service+ item showed the last one's. The switch is off by default (#94).
- With `Latest first on Following` on, every Following read after the first asks TikTok for 30 posts instead of its smaller count. A long list takes fewer reads, and fewer newer posts turn up after you've already scrolled past older ones (#226).
- The profile card in a LIVE room works like a profile now. Long press the bio to copy it, the name to copy the name, or the username to copy the user ID. A small copy mark after the username copies the handle with one tap (#268).
- `Hide TikTok Shop` takes the shop buttons out from under captions too, the ones that link to a product or open a shopping search with the bag icon. A plain search tag under a caption still shows (#271).
- `Custom launcher icon` has a `Notification icon` option now. Pick Hushfeed's H and TikTok's notifications show a sharp H in the status bar instead of the note. TikTok ships that note as one small picture that gets stretched on most phones, so it often looks soft. Leave the option alone and nothing changes (Discussion #114).
- `Sound format` has a third choice, MP3. Both sound saves (the one beside a video and the long-press `Save the original sound`) can come out as a plain .mp3 that plays anywhere. A sound TikTok already sent as MP3 is saved untouched, and anything else is converted on the phone at its own sample rate. MP3 works on every Android version, so the row doesn't grey out below Android 10 anymore. If a conversion fails you get the sound the way TikTok sent it (#273).
- `Also on opened videos` (under `Hide the search button on the feed`) has a `Hide the Back button there too` switch now. It also takes away the Back arrow beside that hidden search bar, so a video opened from search or a profile shows nothing at the top. Your phone's back gesture still works (#251).
- With `Block author button` on, a LIVE that shows up in For You gets the block button too. One tap blocks its host, and the feed moves on like it does after a video. The sound, feedback and mute buttons stay off LIVEs, since they don't apply there (Discussion #138).
- New `Create stickers` patch, on by default. A patched app only gets the basic comment sticker panel, which has no way to make a sticker, so its Saved page gets a Create button. Pick a photo and it shows up first in Saved a moment later, ready to send. A video's share sheet gets `Make sticker` after Download too, and that turns the video's picture into one of your saved stickers (#156, #88).
- New `Keep recent stickers` patch. The sticker panel's Recently used row stays filled after a restart or an account switch now, and your four newest show above Saved. Each account keeps its own row, and nothing is kept while you're signed out (#156).
- `Hide surveys` also hides the Not interested and Interested buttons TikTok sometimes lays over a video (#293).
- `Custom launcher icon` has a Material You style. On Android 12 and up the note and its background take colors from your wallpaper and switch with dark mode, even with themed icons off. Older phones get white on black. A new Icon background color option takes any color written like #1E88E5 and puts it behind the note, or behind your own picture, in any style (#280).
- `Leave after no touch` under Screen time is for anyone who falls asleep with the feed playing. Set it to a number of minutes and TikTok stops the video and goes to the background once nobody has touched the screen for that long, with a short message saying why. Any touch starts the wait over (a key press or a mouse wheel counts too), and so does opening a sheet like Share or the comment menu. It's off until you set it (#266).
- `Show when an account was made` puts "Joined Jan 2020" under the @username on someone else's profile, next to the follow label when that's on too. TikTok doesn't send the date, but every account's ID carries the time it was made, so it's read from there. Very old accounts from the musical.ly days have short IDs with no time in them and show nothing. The same date now fills the Joined line in Account facts when TikTok leaves it out. It's off until you turn it on.
- What's new comes in Simplified Chinese now, the way the settings already did. A phone set to Simplified Chinese gets the translated notes instead of English ones, and Traditional Chinese still gets English.
- The Feature Gate Lab has a restart button now. It shows up on the Lab page once a change needs a restart, the same as on the settings pages, and TikTok opens back on the Lab afterwards. Rules saved while overrides are off don't add to the restart count, since TikTok hasn't read them. The messages after forcing, turning off or resetting gates don't tell you to restart anymore. With overrides off there's nothing to restart for, and with them on the button is right there. Turning overrides on or off still says to restart, since that always needs one.
- Hushfeed builds on Morphe patcher 2.1.0 now, so it needs Morphe Manager 2.3.0 or newer, or morphe-desktop 1.20.0 on a computer.
- The patch bundle is signed with Morphe's own bundle signature, and the source lists the matching public key. Manager can use it to tell whether a later download really came from Hushfeed.

Fixes

- Opening a search result that lives far down a page, like `Double tap` or the Liked grid sort in Feed screen, now lands on that row. It used to open the page at its top, so you had to scroll a long way to find it.
- With `See-through bottom bar` on, the "Swipe up to skip" line on a suggested account card in For You sits above the tabs again instead of behind them (#261).
- The floating tab pill is a little taller now. It reaches just above the bar and the tabs sit in its middle, so the Home icon and its name stay inside the highlight instead of poking out over it. The caption and the video's progress line move up to match, so the line no longer rides on the pill (#259).
- With `Automatic Clear display` on and no delay, opening a second video from Favorites, Likes or a profile no longer flashes TikTok's search bar at the top for a split second before it clears (#84).
- With `AMOLED dark theme` on, the activity center's card is black (or your picked color) instead of TikTok's dark gray. Those history pages are web pages inside TikTok, so the theme never reached them before (#263).
- `Hide unverified content notices` also takes the "Caution · May contain inaccurate information" strip off videos people share with you in messages. That label travels inside the message itself, so the switch didn't reach it before (#258).
- A long press on someone else's bio copies it now. Before, it only got TikTok's translate bubble, because TikTok draws other people's bios with a different part of the app than your own (#247).
- With `Open the comments at full height` on, the sheet stops below the status bar instead of running under the clock and battery icons, and the first video after opening TikTok gets the full height too instead of the usual two thirds (#261).
- Categories open and close right under their rows in the main list. Search shows the matching controls in that same list, and a category you opened stays open after you rotate the phone or restart TikTok.
- The big cards on the settings home page are a compact full-width list now, and Quick setups is gone.
- Country flags and codes stay next to names written right to left (#258).
- With `See-through bottom bar` on, the name and "Tap to watch" line of LIVE previews and mini dramas stay above the tabs (#250).
- The grid sort control has a 48 dp touch target, so it's easier to hit.
- The grid sort control hides while its grid isn't showing and comes back with the grid.
- If a sort change can't be saved, the grid keeps the order it had.
- Choosing Original order keeps the current grid's sort menu available (#180).
- Comments beside the video measures its width the same way when it lays out and when it decides whether to rebuild (#253).
- In Inbox, a reused chat picture now opens the current creator's Story on the first tap when Story-first is on (#233).
- The video stays paused when a link in its comments opens another page. Leaving the tap-to-start cover for another tab keeps its feed paused too (#257).
- Notification reports in Diagnostics count how many notifications were registered and posted, and leave out what the messages said (#126, #222, #86).
- TikTok stays in the app list Android 14 and newer show when you record a single app.
- Hold a settings-search switch to reveal and highlight its control in the main list (#248).
- Startup checks record which player drew the first frame, timed with a clock that never jumps backward (#150).
- Exporting a recovered recording writes in big chunks now, so a large file doesn't take ages to save.
- Recovery Retry keeps the recording's original stop reason instead of saying TikTok closed. Recovery dialogs follow Hushfeed's theme.
- Screen recordings check storage as they run and keep recovery files until the saved copy is verified. Interrupted recordings can be retried, exported or deleted.
- The first frames of a screen recording each keep their own timestamp while the sound is starting.
- Screen recordings keep their first video frames while the sound is still starting up.
- Screen recording releases audio resources when sound can't start. Its save notice now says when the recording has no sound.
- Screen recording now asks Android to capture only the patched app's sound.
- Service+ cleanup checks the first entry in a LIVE preview now, the same one TikTok decides to show (#94).
- The comment pause can tell the first frame is playing before TikTok sends its first progress update (#151).
- `Hide TikTok's Auto scroll button` also hides the round Auto scroll button TikTok shows at the top right of the video on some devices (#234).
- The cover still TikTok flashes between videos grows with the picture under `See-through status bar` and `See-through bottom bar`. Only the video grew before, so every swipe showed TikTok's bands for a frame (#232).
- `Remove feed ads` also refuses the ad microseries ask for in their player. That request went around the feed ad filter, so an episode could still bring one (#286).
- Typing in a LIVE room's comment box reads light on the AMOLED dark theme. The panel went black with the rest of the room, but its text box kept TikTok's dark text and hint, so what you typed was dark on black (#267).
- `Keep a streak going` reaches names with an emoji or a space in them, and group chats. Those entries were cut at the first character a username can't hold, and the field's keyboard wouldn't even let you type them. A group is named the way your Inbox shows it, and one you haven't opened since the last restart is named in the answer so you know to open it (#289).
- Opening TikTok links from Telegram one after another no longer piles a whole For You feed under every profile. Memory stayed high and grew with each link, and Back went from feed to feed instead of out of TikTok. Now each link replaces the pages you'd opened from the last one, and Back from the profile takes you straight back to the chat you came from (#276). That holds when you open a video from the profile, share it and come back to TikTok through Recents. Back used to land on the home screen there.
- `Auto translate comments` works again on accounts TikTok moved to its newer comment list, where nothing got translated. Foreign comments switch to your language as they scroll in, and one you've flipped back with See original stays that way (#282).
- `Hide LIVE videos` catches the LIVEs TikTok slips into a For You page that's already on screen. Those used to get through because Hushfeed leaves TikTok's fresh inserts alone, and the other filters still do (#277).
- The translate icon at the top of the comments shows on while `Auto translate comments` is working, and turning it off now holds. It stays off on every video and every page you scroll to until you tap it back on or flip the switch. Before, it only reset the comments on screen, and TikTok put translation back each time the comments closed (#282).
- `Open the Story when a creator is LIVE` works on a creator's profile picture too. TikTok ranks the LIVE ahead of the Story there, so the tap went into the LIVE (#233).
- Saving a video on Automatic takes the tallest copy other players can open when it's taller than TikTok's own file. TikTok's clean file is often 720p H.264 with a 1080p HEVC listed right beside it, so saves came out smaller than they had to. With the watermark kept you still get TikTok's stamped copy (#240).
- Saving a story on Automatic takes the sharpest copy the story has, the one the player shows. With `Show download progress` or a few other download switches on, it used to save a smaller 720p copy. Thanks to @jutochoppa (#287, #155).
- Recording a LIVE's screen doesn't film the Record button anymore. It hides as the recording starts and comes back once the file is saved. The recording's notification has a Stop button, and leaving the room still stops and saves it (#265).
- `Sign in without a passkey` says what to do when TikTok's 2-step check still asks only for a passkey. That page lists only the ways your account has set up, so add email or text as a way to verify on tiktok.com or another phone first, then sign in (#102).
- `Remove creation tools` never empties the face model on its own anymore, on a build with no editor and effect files, since that left face effects and Beauty unable to find a face (#285). TikTok 47.6.3's split bundle has those files again, so it now works there like it does on the universal APK and the Create tab stops working. Leave it out if you make videos.
- When TikTok turns down a like, Hushfeed tells you. The heart still fills when you tap it, but a like the server refused is gone after a restart, so the first one each session now shows TikTok's reason, or its error code when it gives none. Comment likes count too. With logging on, the diagnostics report says whether each like went through (#269).
- Videos you liked or saved stay on your Liked and Favorites grids now, even when they carry an ad, a paid partnership or a commission mark. `Remove feed ads` and the other feed filters used to take those off the grids too, so a like went through but the video never showed on Liked. The For You and Following feeds still drop them (#269).
- The Chinese message for a refused follow says 关注 now. It used to read "follow" as "the following".
- The floating tab pill blurs a LIVE preview in For You behind it too. Ordinary videos were already blurred there, but a LIVE's stream showed sharp through the glass (#259).
- Around 140 pop-up messages are shorter now, so they fit in the two lines Android 12 and later gives them. The longer ones got cut off partway through, often right where they said what to do next. For some of them the English already fit, and only the translations were trimmed.
- The Feature Gate Lab's pop-up messages fit in two lines now too, and so do the ones you get when a settings change that was cut short gets sorted out on the next launch. An import that brings in nothing new opens the same results dialog as any other import, so you can see what already matched or isn't in this TikTok version. That dialog has no Undo button, since the only thing left to undo would be the Lab change before it. Short hints like "Enter a number" no longer end in a stray full stop, in the Lab or in number fields.
- The Simplified Chinese settings read more evenly. They talk to you the same way throughout and use one word each for an account and a region. Galaxy Store and AppGallery show their real store names, and a few labels that came out wrong, like Own profile counts and Override store region, now say what they do.
- Comment search no longer undoes the keyword filter on translated comments. With both on, a translated comment the filter hid got its space in the list back every time the list drew it again. It now stays hidden whatever the search box holds.
- Picking a download folder that can't be used, like one under Music or on an SD card, opens the folder box again with the folder you picked and the reason under it. It used to be a pop-up message, and the list of allowed folders in it got cut off.

Behind the scenes

- Every LIVE preview and drama label that See-through bottom bar moves is checked against the supported TikTok APK.
- The auto-advance audit follows the video player itself instead of per-video labels. A clip that doesn't finish, or playback it can't read, leaves the check inconclusive.
- The whole-app walk checks the installed build and its patch options.
- Patch audits check the installed APK and which patches were picked. Results from another app, or from a patch left out of the build, only count as history.
- A patch audit waits for the full diagnostics report before it calls a switch missing. With no video to look at, the checks that need one stay inconclusive, and the commenter region check reads the current cache trace.
- A patch audit stops counting for a build once the code it ran against changes, and a partial rerun leaves the older checks as history.
- The patch bundle carries Gson 2.15.0, up from 2.14.0. Morphe Manager uses it while patching to read the patch defaults.
- The Licenses page under About and the NOTICE file now credit De-Vanced, where a few of the build files came from. Those files, and the telemetry patch taken from hxreborn's fork, now link the copies they were actually taken from instead of ReVanced pages that never held them.
- Releases don't carry `release-receipt-<version>.json` anymore. The bundle is byte reproducible, so you can build the tag yourself and compare the checksum.

The [changelog](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/hushfeed/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) has every earlier release too.

How to update

1. Update Morphe Manager to 2.3.0 or newer, then refresh the Hushfeed source.
2. Patch TikTok 47.6.3 from APKMirror. Keep the manager's existing signing key so your login and settings carry over.

The `.mpp` download is a patch bundle, not a TikTok APK. [Installation instructions](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/hushfeed#install).

What was checked

* All 143 TikTok patches applied to TikTok 47.6.3 with none failing.
* This exact bundle was patched onto TikTok 47.6.3 and run on an Android emulator. A walk through the whole app opened 27 screens with no crash.
* Android's own code verifier then read every class of the patched app on that same device, and it found nothing that unpatched TikTok 47.6.3 doesn't already have.

repos.body:
Hushfeed v0.80.0 has 143 patches for global TikTok 47.6.3 (`com.zhiliaoapp.musically`), and it's TikTok only now. PineDrama moved to its own patch set, [HushPine](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushPine), so add that source in Morphe Manager to keep patching PineDrama. This bundle is built on Morphe patcher 2.1.0. Update Morphe Manager to 2.3.0 or newer before you patch (or use morphe-desktop 1.20.0 on a computer), because older ones won't load it.

TikTok moves to 47.6.3, so grab that build from APKMirror and keep the same signing key. Your login and settings carry over. You can lock the feed during hours you pick, keep saves off mobile data, slide to change the hold speed and turn the bottom bar into a floating glass pill. Messages someone unsends can stay in the chat, a double tap can take a like back off, and every patch has Morphe options for its starting values.

Here's every report this release changed something for, and what changed.

For bug reports

* Passkey sign-in (#102). `Sign in without a passkey` says what to do when TikTok's 2-step check still asks only for a passkey.
* Missing notifications (#126, #222, #86). Diagnostics counts how many notifications were registered and posted, and leaves out what they said.
* Lag when a video starts (#150). Startup checks record which player drew the first frame, timed with a clock that never jumps backward.
* A video playing behind the comments (#151). The comment pause can tell the first frame is playing before TikTok sends its first progress update.
* Low download quality (#240). Saving on Automatic takes the tallest copy other players can open when it beats TikTok's own file, which is often the 1080p HEVC one.
* Tabs over LIVE and drama text (#250). With `See-through bottom bar` on, the name and "Tap to watch" line stay above the tabs.
* Comments beside the video (#253). It measures its width the same way when it lays out and when it decides whether to rebuild.
* Two videos playing at once (#257). The video stays paused when a link in its comments opens another page.
* The Caution label in messages (#258). `Hide unverified content notices` takes it off videos people share with you too, and country flags stay next to names written right to left.
* Full height comments under the status bar (#261). The sheet stops below the clock, and the first video after opening TikTok gets the full height too. The "Swipe up to skip" line on suggested accounts sits above the tabs again.
* The activity center in AMOLED (#263). Its card is black, or your picked color, instead of TikTok's dark gray.
* Dark text in a LIVE comment box (#267). What you type there reads light on the AMOLED dark theme.
* Likes missing from Liked (#269). Videos you liked or saved stay on your Liked and Favorites grids even with an ad or paid partnership mark, and a like TikTok turns down now tells you why.
* Profile links from Telegram (#276). Each link replaces the pages you opened from the last one, and Back from the profile goes straight to the chat.
* LIVEs in the feed (#277). `Hide LIVE videos` catches the ones TikTok slips into a page that's already on screen.
* Face effects that can't find a face (#285). `Remove creation tools` doesn't empty the face model on its own anymore. Leave that patch out if you use face effects or make videos.
* Streaks with emoji or group names (#289). `Keep a streak going` reaches names with an emoji or a space in them, and group chats.
* Automatic Clear display (#84). A second video opened from Favorites, Likes or a profile doesn't flash the search bar before it clears.
* The Service+ line under LIVEs (#94). `Hide the Service+ row under LIVE previews` keeps it off, and the line stays with its own LIVE.

For feature requests and contributions

* Sharper story saves (#155, #287). Saving a story on Automatic takes the sharpest copy it has. Thanks to @jutochoppa.
* Stickers (#156, #88). `Create stickers` puts a Create button on the sticker panel's Saved page and `Make sticker` on a video's share sheet, and `Keep recent stickers` keeps the Recently used row after a restart. PineDrama support, the rest of #156, lives in HushPine now.
* Better sorting (#180). Liked grids get their own sort.
* Latest on Following (#226). With `Latest first on Following` on, every read after the first asks TikTok for 30 posts.
* Bands between videos (#232). The cover still TikTok flashes between videos grows with the picture under the see-through bars.
* Stories for creators who are LIVE (#233). `Open the Story when a creator is LIVE` works on a creator's profile picture too.
* The Auto scroll button on foldables (#234). `Hide TikTok's Auto scroll button` also hides the round one at the top right.
* Links in bios (#247). An @username in a bio opens that profile, and a long press on someone else's bio copies it.
* Hold speed slider and double tap unlike (#248). `Slide to change the hold speed` and the `Like or unlike the video` choice come from OmerKurdi79's fork.
* Search from a gesture (#251). `Double tap` and `Long press` can open TikTok's search page, and `Hide the Back button there too` clears the top of opened videos.
* A smaller comment search (#254). `Fold the search into a button` turns the box into a magnifier.
* Starting values for settings (#256). Every patch with settings has Morphe options for them. Thanks to @XEGARE.
* The glass bottom bar (#259). The main feed's bottom bar can be a floating glass pill. Thanks to @amfakh, whose pull request it's based on.
* The LIVE row on Following (#262). `Hide the LIVE row on Following` takes it away.
* The Hushfeed row in TikTok's settings (#264). `Hide the Hushfeed row` takes it out.
* LIVE recordings (#265). Recording a LIVE's screen doesn't film the Record button, and the notification has a Stop button.
* Copying from a LIVE profile card (#268). Long press the bio, name or username to copy it.
* Shop buttons under captions (#271). `Hide TikTok Shop` takes those out too.
* MP3 saves (#273). `Sound format` has an MP3 choice.
* The sticker save box (#274). `Save box for chat stickers` turns it off.
* Material You icons (#280). `Custom launcher icon` has a Material You style and an icon background color.
* Auto translate (#282). `Auto translate comments` works on TikTok's newer comment list, and the translate icon's off state holds.
* Music from other apps (#283). `Let other apps play until a video starts` keeps it playing until a video does.
* Ads in microseries (#286). `Remove feed ads` refuses the ads microseries ask for in their player.
* Unsent messages (#291). `Keep unsent messages` keeps them in the chat. Thanks to @maayan080.
* Interested buttons on videos (#293). `Hide surveys` hides them.
* A sharper notification icon (Discussion #114). `Custom launcher icon` has a `Notification icon` option.
* Blocking a LIVE host (Discussion #138). `Block author button` works on LIVEs in For You.

New in this release

- PineDrama moved out to its own repo, [HushPine](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushPine), with its own patches and releases. Hushfeed is TikTok only from here on, and `Allow photo comments` went with PineDrama.
- Hushfeed now supports TikTok 47.6.3, and only that one. 47.5.3 isn't supported anymore. Grab the 47.6.3 bundle or APK from APKMirror and patch it with the same signing key, so your login and settings carry over.
- `Hide the Clear display controls` has a new `Keep the progress bar` switch under it. The exit and pause buttons still go, but the progress bar stays on screen so you can see where you are and drag it (#237).
- `Double tap` has a new `Like or unlike the video` choice. A double tap on a video you've already liked takes the like back off, the same as tapping the heart, and `Confirm before liking` still asks first. TikTok's default double tap still only likes, and it works for each corner with `Double tap by corner` too (#248).
- `Slide to change the hold speed` lets you pick the speed while you hold a video. Slide left or right and it steps through your own `Speed menu choices`, with a bubble near the top showing the speed. Let go and the video goes back to its usual speed, and your next hold starts at the speed you slid to. With `Lock the hold speed with a pull down` on, pulling down locks the speed you slid to, and unlocking plays your default speed when `Use a default playback speed` is on. It's off by default and sits right under `Speed while you hold the video`. The idea comes from OmerKurdi79's fork (#248).
- Liked grids get their own sort. `Sort loaded videos on Liked grids` starts at `Same as profile grids`, so nothing changes until you pick something else, and the sort button on a Liked grid now changes only the Liked order. Posts, Favorites and private videos still follow the profile setting, and other kinds of grids keep TikTok's order (#180).
- Every Hushfeed title (the settings bar, its dialogs, the Feature Gate Lab and the lock screen) now wears TikTok's cyan and red in a slow moving gradient, and it keeps moving even with Android's animations turned off.
- The Calm feed preset is gone from the top of Feed filter. The filters it used to flip are all still there, and whatever you turned on with it stays on.
- `Double tap` and `Long press` can open TikTok's search page now. It works with `Hide feed search button` on too, so you can hide the button and still get to Search (#251).
- `Fold the search into a button` puts a magnifier at the top left of the comments in place of the search box. Tap it to search, and searching (or another tap) folds the box away again. Your search keeps filtering, and the result line stays so you can tell (#254).
- `Hide the Hushfeed row` takes Hushfeed out of TikTok's Settings and privacy. Press and hold For You at the top of the feed to open the settings after that, or Home when `Long-press Home for Hushfeed settings` is on. Pausing Hushfeed brings the row back (#264).
- An @username typed into someone's bio is a link now, like the ones TikTok already links. Tap it and that profile opens. Tapping the rest of the bio still translates it, and a long press still copies it. A name right after "IG:" or "Snap" stays plain, since it belongs to another app. Turn it off with `Tap @names in bios` (#247).
- The main feed's bottom bar can be a floating glass pill now. A lens slides across the tabs as you switch, you can slide along the pill to change tabs, and haptics are optional. Interface has new settings for the blur, the glass opacity, the pill's height and its corners (#259).
- Every patch with settings now has Morphe options that pick its starting values, so a build can ship with the switches you want already on. Saved choices still win, and Reset goes back to the value you picked. Thanks to @XEGARE (#256).
- `Hide the LIVE row on Following` takes away the row of LIVE and story circles at the top of Following, along with the Story pill that opens it. The video starts right under the tabs with no empty band, and it stays that way after a swipe or Clear display. For You and the LIVE tab look the same as before (#262).
- `Skip the Share to sheet after a save` stops the Share to sheet TikTok pops up a few seconds after its own downloader saves a video. The share button works like before and the saved notice still shows.
- `Save details beside the video` covers photo posts now. Saving a post's original photos also writes one file for the whole post with its caption, creator, link and post date, plus which photos you picked and which ones saved. `Save details as JSON` works for it too. A Retry after some photos failed updates that same file instead of adding a second one, and if the file can't be written you're told separately from the photos.
- Search knows the everyday names for a few features now. Try "autoplay", "PiP", "AI" or "save photos". It also finds a choice row by any of its options, whichever one it's set to. Search "save the frame" and `Double tap` comes up, and tapping it opens its list of choices. Titles that match what you typed still come first.
- `Lock the feed at set times` locks the feed by itself during hours you pick, like `Mon-Fri 21:00-07:00; Sat Sun 13:00-15:00`. Leave the days out and it's every day, and a time that ends before it starts runs past midnight. It follows your phone's clock, daylight saving changes included. The lock panel says when it opens again, and the row shows when the next lock starts. Messages, profiles and search still work while it's on. A spent daily budget still wins, and Pause Hushfeed turns it off. Cutting hours waits a day, just like budget changes do, and you can't take hours off a day that's already locked.
- `Save only on Wi-Fi` keeps saves off mobile data. On a metered network, or when the phone can't tell, a save waits for Wi-Fi (or any network that isn't metered) for up to 30 minutes. A waiting save doesn't take one of the `Saves at once` spots, and you can cancel it from the Downloads page. Leave Wi-Fi in the middle of a save and it stops cleanly, with the finished files kept. Saving a frame still works anywhere. It's off by default.
- `Save box for chat stickers` in Downloads turns off the Save media box Hushfeed opens when you tap a sticker someone sent you in a chat. With it off, the tap only does what TikTok does (#274).
- `Let other apps play until a video starts` sits under `Mute feed videos` in Playback. With it on, opening TikTok or going back and forth to your messages doesn't pause music from another app anymore. TikTok takes the sound once a video actually plays. It's off by default (#283).
- New `Keep unsent messages` switch in Inbox. When someone unsends a message to you, it stays in the chat, and `Mark kept messages` can add "(unsent)" after it. Messages you unsend yourself still go away, and `Clear kept messages` turns the kept ones back into TikTok's usual notice. It's off by default. Thanks to @maayan080 (#291).
- `Hide the Service+ row under LIVE previews` sits with the LIVE switches in Playback. A LIVE in the feed can carry a Service+ line under the creator's name, like "Ask me anything", and this keeps it off. The line also stays with its own LIVE now. It used to hang on from the LIVE before whenever the row came back on screen, so a LIVE with no Service+ item showed the last one's. The switch is off by default (#94).
- With `Latest first on Following` on, every Following read after the first asks TikTok for 30 posts instead of its smaller count. A long list takes fewer reads, and fewer newer posts turn up after you've already scrolled past older ones (#226).
- The profile card in a LIVE room works like a profile now. Long press the bio to copy it, the name to copy the name, or the username to copy the user ID. A small copy mark after the username copies the handle with one tap (#268).
- `Hide TikTok Shop` takes the shop buttons out from under captions too, the ones that link to a product or open a shopping search with the bag icon. A plain search tag under a caption still shows (#271).
- `Custom launcher icon` has a `Notification icon` option now. Pick Hushfeed's H and TikTok's notifications show a sharp H in the status bar instead of the note. TikTok ships that note as one small picture that gets stretched on most phones, so it often looks soft. Leave the option alone and nothing changes (Discussion #114).
- `Sound format` has a third choice, MP3. Both sound saves (the one beside a video and the long-press `Save the original sound`) can come out as a plain .mp3 that plays anywhere. A sound TikTok already sent as MP3 is saved untouched, and anything else is converted on the phone at its own sample rate. MP3 works on every Android version, so the row doesn't grey out below Android 10 anymore. If a conversion fails you get the sound the way TikTok sent it (#273).
- `Also on opened videos` (under `Hide the search button on the feed`) has a `Hide the Back button there too` switch now. It also takes away the Back arrow beside that hidden search bar, so a video opened from search or a profile shows nothing at the top. Your phone's back gesture still works (#251).
- With `Block author button` on, a LIVE that shows up in For You gets the block button too. One tap blocks its host, and the feed moves on like it does after a video. The sound, feedback and mute buttons stay off LIVEs, since they don't apply there (Discussion #138).
- New `Create stickers` patch, on by default. A patched app only gets the basic comment sticker panel, which has no way to make a sticker, so its Saved page gets a Create button. Pick a photo and it shows up first in Saved a moment later, ready to send. A video's share sheet gets `Make sticker` after Download too, and that turns the video's picture into one of your saved stickers (#156, #88).
- New `Keep recent stickers` patch. The sticker panel's Recently used row stays filled after a restart or an account switch now, and your four newest show above Saved. Each account keeps its own row, and nothing is kept while you're signed out (#156).
- `Hide surveys` also hides the Not interested and Interested buttons TikTok sometimes lays over a video (#293).
- `Custom launcher icon` has a Material You style. On Android 12 and up the note and its background take colors from your wallpaper and switch with dark mode, even with themed icons off. Older phones get white on black. A new Icon background color option takes any color written like #1E88E5 and puts it behind the note, or behind your own picture, in any style (#280).
- `Leave after no touch` under Screen time is for anyone who falls asleep with the feed playing. Set it to a number of minutes and TikTok stops the video and goes to the background once nobody has touched the screen for that long, with a short message saying why. Any touch starts the wait over (a key press or a mouse wheel counts too), and so does opening a sheet like Share or the comment menu. It's off until you set it (#266).
- `Show when an account was made` puts "Joined Jan 2020" under the @username on someone else's profile, next to the follow label when that's on too. TikTok doesn't send the date, but every account's ID carries the time it was made, so it's read from there. Very old accounts from the musical.ly days have short IDs with no time in them and show nothing. The same date now fills the Joined line in Account facts when TikTok leaves it out. It's off until you turn it on.
- What's new comes in Simplified Chinese now, the way the settings already did. A phone set to Simplified Chinese gets the translated notes instead of English ones, and Traditional Chinese still gets English.
- The Feature Gate Lab has a restart button now. It shows up on the Lab page once a change needs a restart, the same as on the settings pages, and TikTok opens back on the Lab afterwards. Rules saved while overrides are off don't add to the restart count, since TikTok hasn't read them. The messages after forcing, turning off or resetting gates don't tell you to restart anymore. With overrides off there's nothing to restart for, and with them on the button is right there. Turning overrides on or off still says to restart, since that always needs one.
- Hushfeed builds on Morphe patcher 2.1.0 now, so it needs Morphe Manager 2.3.0 or newer, or morphe-desktop 1.20.0 on a computer.
- The patch bundle is signed with Morphe's own bundle signature, and the source lists the matching public key. Manager can use it to tell whether a later download really came from Hushfeed.

Fixes

- Opening a search result that lives far down a page, like `Double tap` or the Liked grid sort in Feed screen, now lands on that row. It used to open the page at its top, so you had to scroll a long way to find it.
- With `See-through bottom bar` on, the "Swipe up to skip" line on a suggested account card in For You sits above the tabs again instead of behind them (#261).
- The floating tab pill is a little taller now. It reaches just above the bar and the tabs sit in its middle, so the Home icon and its name stay inside the highlight instead of poking out over it. The caption and the video's progress line move up to match, so the line no longer rides on the pill (#259).
- With `Automatic Clear display` on and no delay, opening a second video from Favorites, Likes or a profile no longer flashes TikTok's search bar at the top for a split second before it clears (#84).
- With `AMOLED dark theme` on, the activity center's card is black (or your picked color) instead of TikTok's dark gray. Those history pages are web pages inside TikTok, so the theme never reached them before (#263).
- `Hide unverified content notices` also takes the "Caution · May contain inaccurate information" strip off videos people share with you in messages. That label travels inside the message itself, so the switch didn't reach it before (#258).
- A long press on someone else's bio copies it now. Before, it only got TikTok's translate bubble, because TikTok draws other people's bios with a different part of the app than your own (#247).
- With `Open the comments at full height` on, the sheet stops below the status bar instead of running under the clock and battery icons, and the first video after opening TikTok gets the full height too instead of the usual two thirds (#261).
- Categories open and close right under their rows in the main list. Search shows the matching controls in that same list, and a category you opened stays open after you rotate the phone or restart TikTok.
- The big cards on the settings home page are a compact full-width list now, and Quick setups is gone.
- Country flags and codes stay next to names written right to left (#258).
- With `See-through bottom bar` on, the name and "Tap to watch" line of LIVE previews and mini dramas stay above the tabs (#250).
- The grid sort control has a 48 dp touch target, so it's easier to hit.
- The grid sort control hides while its grid isn't showing and comes back with the grid.
- If a sort change can't be saved, the grid keeps the order it had.
- Choosing Original order keeps the current grid's sort menu available (#180).
- Comments beside the video measures its width the same way when it lays out and when it decides whether to rebuild (#253).
- In Inbox, a reused chat picture now opens the current creator's Story on the first tap when Story-first is on (#233).
- The video stays paused when a link in its comments opens another page. Leaving the tap-to-start cover for another tab keeps its feed paused too (#257).
- Notification reports in Diagnostics count how many notifications were registered and posted, and leave out what the messages said (#126, #222, #86).
- TikTok stays in the app list Android 14 and newer show when you record a single app.
- Hold a settings-search switch to reveal and highlight its control in the main list (#248).
- Startup checks record which player drew the first frame, timed with a clock that never jumps backward (#150).
- Exporting a recovered recording writes in big chunks now, so a large file doesn't take ages to save.
- Recovery Retry keeps the recording's original stop reason instead of saying TikTok closed. Recovery dialogs follow Hushfeed's theme.
- Screen recordings check storage as they run and keep recovery files until the saved copy is verified. Interrupted recordings can be retried, exported or deleted.
- The first frames of a screen recording each keep their own timestamp while the sound is starting.
- Screen recordings keep their first video frames while the sound is still starting up.
- Screen recording releases audio resources when sound can't start. Its save notice now says when the recording has no sound.
- Screen recording now asks Android to capture only the patched app's sound.
- Service+ cleanup checks the first entry in a LIVE preview now, the same one TikTok decides to show (#94).
- The comment pause can tell the first frame is playing before TikTok sends its first progress update (#151).
- `Hide TikTok's Auto scroll button` also hides the round Auto scroll button TikTok shows at the top right of the video on some devices (#234).
- The cover still TikTok flashes between videos grows with the picture under `See-through status bar` and `See-through bottom bar`. Only the video grew before, so every swipe showed TikTok's bands for a frame (#232).
- `Remove feed ads` also refuses the ad microseries ask for in their player. That request went around the feed ad filter, so an episode could still bring one (#286).
- Typing in a LIVE room's comment box reads light on the AMOLED dark theme. The panel went black with the rest of the room, but its text box kept TikTok's dark text and hint, so what you typed was dark on black (#267).
- `Keep a streak going` reaches names with an emoji or a space in them, and group chats. Those entries were cut at the first character a username can't hold, and the field's keyboard wouldn't even let you type them. A group is named the way your Inbox shows it, and one you haven't opened since the last restart is named in the answer so you know to open it (#289).
- Opening TikTok links from Telegram one after another no longer piles a whole For You feed under every profile. Memory stayed high and grew with each link, and Back went from feed to feed instead of out of TikTok. Now each link replaces the pages you'd opened from the last one, and Back from the profile takes you straight back to the chat you came from (#276). That holds when you open a video from the profile, share it and come back to TikTok through Recents. Back used to land on the home screen there.
- `Auto translate comments` works again on accounts TikTok moved to its newer comment list, where nothing got translated. Foreign comments switch to your language as they scroll in, and one you've flipped back with See original stays that way (#282).
- `Hide LIVE videos` catches the LIVEs TikTok slips into a For You page that's already on screen. Those used to get through because Hushfeed leaves TikTok's fresh inserts alone, and the other filters still do (#277).
- The translate icon at the top of the comments shows on while `Auto translate comments` is working, and turning it off now holds. It stays off on every video and every page you scroll to until you tap it back on or flip the switch. Before, it only reset the comments on screen, and TikTok put translation back each time the comments closed (#282).
- `Open the Story when a creator is LIVE` works on a creator's profile picture too. TikTok ranks the LIVE ahead of the Story there, so the tap went into the LIVE (#233).
- Saving a video on Automatic takes the tallest copy other players can open when it's taller than TikTok's own file. TikTok's clean file is often 720p H.264 with a 1080p HEVC listed right beside it, so saves came out smaller than they had to. With the watermark kept you still get TikTok's stamped copy (#240).
- Saving a story on Automatic takes the sharpest copy the story has, the one the player shows. With `Show download progress` or a few other download switches on, it used to save a smaller 720p copy. Thanks to @jutochoppa (#287, #155).
- Recording a LIVE's screen doesn't film the Record button anymore. It hides as the recording starts and comes back once the file is saved. The recording's notification has a Stop button, and leaving the room still stops and saves it (#265).
- `Sign in without a passkey` says what to do when TikTok's 2-step check still asks only for a passkey. That page lists only the ways your account has set up, so add email or text as a way to verify on tiktok.com or another phone first, then sign in (#102).
- `Remove creation tools` never empties the face model on its own anymore, on a build with no editor and effect files, since that left face effects and Beauty unable to find a face (#285). TikTok 47.6.3's split bundle has those files again, so it now works there like it does on the universal APK and the Create tab stops working. Leave it out if you make videos.
- When TikTok turns down a like, Hushfeed tells you. The heart still fills when you tap it, but a like the server refused is gone after a restart, so the first one each session now shows TikTok's reason, or its error code when it gives none. Comment likes count too. With logging on, the diagnostics report says whether each like went through (#269).
- Videos you liked or saved stay on your Liked and Favorites grids now, even when they carry an ad, a paid partnership or a commission mark. `Remove feed ads` and the other feed filters used to take those off the grids too, so a like went through but the video never showed on Liked. The For You and Following feeds still drop them (#269).
- The Chinese message for a refused follow says 关注 now. It used to read "follow" as "the following".
- The floating tab pill blurs a LIVE preview in For You behind it too. Ordinary videos were already blurred there, but a LIVE's stream showed sharp through the glass (#259).
- Around 140 pop-up messages are shorter now, so they fit in the two lines Android 12 and later gives them. The longer ones got cut off partway through, often right where they said what to do next. For some of them the English already fit, and only the translations were trimmed.
- The Feature Gate Lab's pop-up messages fit in two lines now too, and so do the ones you get when a settings change that was cut short gets sorted out on the next launch. An import that brings in nothing new opens the same results dialog as any other import, so you can see what already matched or isn't in this TikTok version. That dialog has no Undo button, since the only thing left to undo would be the Lab change before it. Short hints like "Enter a number" no longer end in a stray full stop, in the Lab or in number fields.
- The Simplified Chinese settings read more evenly. They talk to you the same way throughout and use one word each for an account and a region. Galaxy Store and AppGallery show their real store names, and a few labels that came out wrong, like Own profile counts and Override store region, now say what they do.
- Comment search no longer undoes the keyword filter on translated comments. With both on, a translated comment the filter hid got its space in the list back every time the list drew it again. It now stays hidden whatever the search box holds.
- Picking a download folder that can't be used, like one under Music or on an SD card, opens the folder box again with the folder you picked and the reason under it. It used to be a pop-up message, and the list of allowed folders in it got cut off.

Behind the scenes

- Every LIVE preview and drama label that See-through bottom bar moves is checked against the supported TikTok APK.
- The auto-advance audit follows the video player itself instead of per-video labels. A clip that doesn't finish, or playback it can't read, leaves the check inconclusive.
- The whole-app walk checks the installed build and its patch options.
- Patch audits check the installed APK and which patches were picked. Results from another app, or from a patch left out of the build, only count as history.
- A patch audit waits for the full diagnostics report before it calls a switch missing. With no video to look at, the checks that need one stay inconclusive, and the commenter region check reads the current cache trace.
- A patch audit stops counting for a build once the code it ran against changes, and a partial rerun leaves the older checks as history.
- The patch bundle carries Gson 2.15.0, up from 2.14.0. Morphe Manager uses it while patching to read the patch defaults.
- The Licenses page under About and the NOTICE file now credit De-Vanced, where a few of the build files came from. Those files, and the telemetry patch taken from hxreborn's fork, now link the copies they were actually taken from instead of ReVanced pages that never held them.
- Releases don't carry `release-receipt-<version>.json` anymore. The bundle is byte reproducible, so you can build the tag yourself and compare the checksum.

The [changelog](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/hushfeed/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) has every earlier release too.

How to update

1. Update Morphe Manager to 2.3.0 or newer, then refresh the Hushfeed source.
2. Patch TikTok 47.6.3 from APKMirror. Keep the manager's existing signing key so your login and settings carry over.

The `.mpp` download is a patch bundle, not a TikTok APK. [Installation instructions](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/hushfeed#install).

What was checked

* All 143 TikTok patches applied to TikTok 47.6.3 with none failing.
* This exact bundle was patched onto TikTok 47.6.3 and run on an Android emulator. A walk through the whole app opened 27 screens with no crash.
* Android's own code verifier then read every class of the patched app on that same device, and it found nothing that unpatched TikTok 47.6.3 doesn't already have.
